exercises.title: Validation practices 1 — which practice?
exercises.problemHtml:
Four validation practices: review the requirements, test the requirements, define acceptance criteria, simulate the requirements. Which one does each action apply?

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: Validation practices 2 — what makes up acceptance criteria?
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers: acceptance criteria may combine (1) passing acceptance tests based on user requirements, (2) satisfying specific nonfunctional requirements, (3) the state of open defects and issues, and (4) infrastructure and training ready for rollout. Classify each criterion.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: Validation practices 3 — reviews and tests
exercises.problemHtml:
Peer review — especially inspection — is one of the highest-value quality practices: a small team with different perspectives examines requirements and models for defects. Tests are an alternative view of the requirements: writing them forces you to think about how you would know the functionality is correct; map tests to functional requirements so none is overlooked.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Review (đặc biệt inspection) giá trị cao; test là góc nhìn khác của yêu cầu, ánh xạ test ↔ yêu cầu chức năng.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md

# Validation practices 3 — reviews and tests — answer key

1. Who should take part in a requirements review?Ai nên tham gia review yêu cầu?
   Answer: d) A small team with different perspectives: analyst, customer, developer, tester
   Different perspectives find different defects.VI: Góc nhìn khác nhau tìm lỗi khác nhau.

2. Why map tests to functional requirements?Vì sao ánh xạ test với yêu cầu chức năng?
   Answer: b) So no requirement is overlooked and every test has a purpose
   Coverage both ways.VI: Phủ hai chiều.

3. Simulation of requirements is…Mô phỏng yêu cầu là…
   Answer: d) a supplement to elicitation and analysis, not a substitute
   Wiegers: supplement, not substitute.VI: Wiegers: bổ trợ, không thay thế.
